title: Listening
description: The four Listening task types, from single exchanges to academic talks, with note-taking for longer audio that is played only once.

id.title: Listening
id.description: Empat tipe soal Listening, dari percakapan satu giliran sampai kuliah akademik, plus mencatat untuk audio panjang yang hanya diputar sekali.

nodes.title: Listen and Choose a Response
nodes.summary: Hear one line of a conversation and choose the most natural reply.

objectives.text: Recognise what the speaker wants (request, suggestion, complaint, offer)
Choose a reply that fits the intent, not just the words heard
Understand indirect answers and common spoken patterns

id.title: Listen and Choose a Response
id.summary: Mendengar satu ujaran dalam percakapan dan memilih balasan yang paling wajar.

objectives.speaker-intent: Mengenali maksud pembicara (permintaan, saran, keluhan, tawaran)
objectives.natural-reply: Memilih balasan yang sesuai maksud, bukan sekadar kata yang terdengar
objectives.indirect-answers: Memahami jawaban tidak langsung dan pola ujaran lisan yang umum

nodes.title: Listen to a Conversation
nodes.summary: Follow a short conversation, mostly about campus life, and answer questions on it.

objectives.text: Identify the problem or topic of the conversation
Recall key details and the decision the speakers reach
Infer a speaker's attitude or what they will probably do next

id.title: Listen to a Conversation
id.summary: Mengikuti percakapan pendek, kebanyakan tentang kehidupan kampus, lalu menjawab soal tentangnya.

objectives.conversation-details: Mengingat detail penting dan keputusan yang diambil para pembicara
objectives.speaker-attitude: Menyimpulkan sikap pembicara atau apa yang kemungkinan akan ia lakukan selanjutnya

nodes.title: Listen to an Announcement
nodes.summary: Understand a classroom or campus announcement: its purpose, key information and next steps.

objectives.text: State the purpose of an announcement
Catch key information such as changes, dates and locations
Predict what listeners are expected to do next

id.title: Listen to an Announcement
id.summary: Memahami pengumuman di kelas atau kampus: tujuan, informasi penting dan langkah berikutnya.

objectives.announcement-info: Menangkap informasi penting seperti perubahan, tanggal dan lokasi
objectives.next-action: Memperkirakan apa yang diharapkan dilakukan pendengar selanjutnya

nodes.title: Note-Taking for Listening
nodes.summary: Take quick, useful notes on audio you hear only once.

objectives.text: Organise notes into main points and supporting details
Use abbreviations and symbols to write faster
Notice signal words that mark new points, examples and conclusions

id.title: Mencatat Saat Listening
id.summary: Membuat catatan cepat dan berguna dari audio yang hanya diputar sekali.

objectives.note-structure: Menyusun catatan menjadi poin utama dan detail pendukung
objectives.abbreviations: Menggunakan singkatan dan simbol agar mencatat lebih cepat
objectives.signal-words: Memperhatikan kata penanda yang menandai poin baru, contoh dan kesimpulan

nodes.title: Listen to an Academic Talk
nodes.summary: Follow a short talk by a professor or expert: main idea, organisation and inference.

objectives.text: Identify the main idea of an academic talk
Explain how the speaker organises information and uses examples
Make inferences and interpret less common or idiomatic expressions

id.title: Listen to an Academic Talk
id.summary: Mengikuti kuliah singkat dosen atau pakar: gagasan utama, susunan dan inferensi.

objectives.talk-main-idea: Menentukan gagasan utama sebuah kuliah akademik
objectives.talk-organisation: Menjelaskan cara pembicara menyusun informasi dan menggunakan contoh
objectives.talk-inference: Membuat inferensi dan menafsirkan ungkapan yang jarang dipakai atau idiomatis
